notes.title: Matrix Games teams up with Yobowargames
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30902484/c6e03f1b3228549ebcc0f0a8e7fa0ac97787c6c6.jpg

Hi everybody!

We have exciting news for you.

Yobowargames is teaming up with Slitherine Ltd., to bring more traditional hex and counter war/historical themed board games to the digital world!

Battle for Korsun and Kursk - Battle at Prochorovka are now part of the Matrix/Slitherine Games catalog. 

To celebrate this important milestone, Korsun has been updated to version 1.0.10 (Changelog below)

- Improved Minimap
- New button in top left to show/hide Minimap
- Mouse scroll will now show zoomed out view
- Selecting a stack of units will automatically select top unit. Previously would select the whole stack to move.
- Shift+left click to select whole stack
- Units that cannot move on turn one are now greyed out

IMPORTANT
The 1.0.10 update for Korsun on available for Android while for iOS is coming soon.

notes.title: 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
Hi All

A small update:

Fixes

 Fixed save games not showing up as saved games in the menu on Mac


New

 Options (effects and sound) in the menu are now saved and remembered when the game restarted
 Added keys for turning off sound while in the game. "-" to turn off sound and "+" to turn on.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Hi All 

Some new updates following feedback from the community:

First up PBEM

PBEM now has basic support in the game. Select the PBEM option and start and play the game as normal. Once your turn is complete the game will save the game out to your user directory. - \Korsun\PBEMSavedGame

Example
C:\Users\myusername\Korsun\PBEMSavedGame

In the PBEMSavedGame folder is a file called KorsunPBEM. This is the file you will need to send to your opponent.

Do not change the name of the file.

Your opponent should then save this file to the same folder on their computer.
Again, do not change the name of the file. They can then load the game from the saved games options in the Game Menu. The saved game will clearly be labeled as Email game.

You can only have one file in the PBEMSavedGame at a time.

Other small fixes/changes

After viewing the strategic map you will be returned to the same position on the main map.

More detail have been added in the English manual regarding combat.

notes.title: Small update 1.0.2
notes.content:
